IEC 60947-1 is the standard which lays the rules applicable to low voltage switchgear and controlgear. The purpose of this standard is to coordinate the rules and regulations in order to obtain uniformity of requirements and tests. The product standard forming the series of IEC standard covering low voltage switchgear and control gear are:

This standard concerns, when required by the relevant product standard, to switchgear and controlgear herein after referred to as “equipment” and intended to be connected to circuits, the rated voltage of which does not exceed 1000 V a.c. or 1500 V d.c.
It does not relate to low-voltage switchgear and controlgear assemblies which are dealt with in IEC 60439.
List of test performed for this standard are :

rows: Switches, disconnectors, switch-disconnectors and fuse-combination units
Control circuit devices and switching elements
Control units for build in thermal protection (PTC ) for rotating electric machine.
Short circuit making and breaking capacities
Degree of protection of enclosed equipment
